Problem 1

(a) Plot the model ACF
```{r, warning=FALSE}
library(forecast)
ma_acf = ARMAacf(ma=c(0.7, rep(0, 10), -0.5, -0.7*0.5), lag.max = 30, pacf = F)
plot(ma_acf, type = "h")
```

(b) Generate time series data of length 300
```{r, warning=FALSE}
library(astsa)

set.seed(99)
ma = sarima.sim(ma=0.7, sma=-0.5, S=12, n=300)

par(mfrow=c(1,1))
plot.ts(ma)

par(mfrow=c(1, 2))
par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1))
acf(ma, lag.max = 30)
pacf(ma, lag.max = 30)
```

(c) For the generated data, fit a SARIMA model



```{r}
sarima.mod = Arima(ma, 
                   order = c(0, 0, 1), 
                   seasonal = c(0, 0, 1),
                   method = "ML",
                   include.mean = F)
sarima.mod
```

(d) Produce forecasts for the generated data for 12 steps ahead
```{r}
h = 12
ma.forecast = forecast(sarima.mod, h)

plot(ma.forecast)
```

Problem 2

(a)
```{r}
ts0 = read.table('airpass.txt')
airpass2 = ts0$V1[-(133:144)]
airpass2log = log(airpass2)

ts = ts(data=airpass2log, frequency = 12)

n <- length(ts)
tt <- seq(1,n)
tt2 <- tt^2

cos12 <- cos(2*pi*tt/12)
sin12 <- sin(2*pi*tt/12)
cos6 <- cos(2*pi*tt/6)
sin6 <- sin(2*pi*tt/6)
cos4 <- cos(2*pi*tt/4)
sin4 <- sin(2*pi*tt/4)

rg <- lm(ts ~ tt + tt2 + cos12 + sin12 + cos6 + sin6 + cos4 + sin4)
summary(rg)

# Fit a stationary SARIMA model on the residuals
ts2 <- ts(residuals(rg), frequency=12)

auto.ts2 <- auto.arima(ts2, max.p = 2, max.q = 2, max.d = 2,
                          start.p = 0, start.q = 0, 
                          max.P = 2, max.Q = 2, max.D = 2,
                          start.P = 0, start.Q = 0, 
                          stationary = TRUE, allowdrift = FALSE, ic = "aic")
auto.ts2

# Forecasts
h = 12
resid.forecast <- forecast(auto.ts2, h)

t_h = (133:144)
trend_seasonal.forecast = rg$coefficients[1]+rg$coefficients[2]*t_h+rg$coefficients[3]*t_h^2+rg$coefficients[4]*cos(2*pi*t_h/12)+rg$coefficients[5]*sin(2*pi*t_h/12)+rg$coefficients[6]*cos(2*pi*t_h/6)+rg$coefficients[7]*sin(2*pi*t_h/6)+rg$coefficients[8]*cos(2*pi*t_h/4)+rg$coefficients[9]*sin(2*pi*t_h/4)

# Translate forecasts Back to the Original Time Series
original_forecast = exp(trend_seasonal.forecast+resid.forecast$mean)

plot.ts(ts0, xlim = c(1, 144), ylim = c(0, 650))
lines(t_h, original_forecast, lty = 2, lwd = 2, col = "red")
```

(b)
```{r}
ts0 = read.table('airpass.txt')
airpass2 = ts0$V1[-(133:144)]
airpass2log = log(airpass2)

ts = ts(data=airpass2log, frequency = 12)

sarima_mod_ts = auto.arima(ts, max.p = 5, max.q = 5, max.d = 1,
                          start.p = 0, start.q = 0, 
                          max.P = 5, max.Q = 5, max.D = 12,
                          start.P = 0, start.Q = 0, 
                          allowdrift = FALSE, ic = "aic")
sarima_mod_ts

h = 12
t_h = (133:144)

sarima_mod_ts.forecast = exp(forecast(sarima_mod_ts, h)$mean)

plot.ts(ts0, xlim = c(1, 144), ylim = c(0, 650))
lines(t_h, sarima_mod_ts.forecast, lty = 2, lwd = 2, col = "blue")
```

(c)

The approach in part (a) gives smaller errors.

```{r}
# part (a) model
sum((original_forecast - ts0$V1[133:144])^2)

# part (b) model
sum((sarima_mod_ts.forecast - ts0$V1[133:144])^2)
```
